required_gates_in_order: Do not query/restart/dispatch the existing producing run or create a competing729 cold build. The recorded729 are only potential source matches; v2 logs are not objects.
Wait for the sole existing v3 run and its always-upload checkpoint; root binds immutable artifact ID, digest, source commit, run and attempt. No second dispatch or concurrent duplicate 729 build.

Verify downloaded checkpoint content-addressed objects and CHECKPOINT.json against its separately bound upload receipt. RAW_FILES.jsonl and quarantine entries are evidence only, never restore permission.

Require producing runtime_audit_valid and all_dependency_source_pins_valid. Accept only individual completed_guarded_compile_candidate records with nonquarantine classification and complete output-bound guarded source commands. A globally failed v3 run may still contain qualifying individual candidates.

Rebind each module's exact source bytes and each actual compile-time IO input. Source identity is per module, not a blanket equality of global manifest hashes. New unrelated source/data inventory does not invalidate an unchanged predecessor.

Compare actual source flags, trust, runtime tool binaries, dependency checkouts, platform/architecture, toolchain native shared libraries, dynamically loaded plugins and system/native ABI receipts. Fixed revisions alone do not prove artifact or ABI equality.

Reacquire ordinary mathlib cache at the pinned source revision and require its actual imported facet hashes to equal recorded values; its bytes were deliberately not reuploaded. Validate independently saved guarded package/Cache/native facets by the same standards.

Resolve every actual import from the producer setup map, including private/server/IR facets and plugins. Traverse dependencies before dependants. A changed/missing import artifact or unbound predecessor invalidates every affected dependant even when its .lean bytes are unchanged.

Require trace/setup/source-command agreement, complete declared facet set and content hashes. Any existing Lake descriptor/.hash contradiction quarantines the candidate. Absent sidecars do not waive cryptographic rebind. Do not synthesize successful Lake traces or rely on depHash alone.

Keep producer and consumer canonical project/package paths identical when possible. Otherwise root must independently review any relocation equivalence before use; this stage never silently edits setup/trace paths or treats changed source command paths as automatically equivalent.

Copy only the complete accepted coherent facet set atomically. Preserve olean, ilean, trace/setup/hash files, required private/server/IR facets and required C/BC/native/link/plugin outputs together. Rehash every copied output and record both producer and consumer identities.

Emit explicit active_modules, accepted_reuse_modules, required_new_build_modules, inventory_only_modules and invalidation reasons. Require a root-reviewed REBIND_PASS before building. Never silently fall back to rebuilding the overlapping 552/729 modules while v3 is still running.

Build only genuine active target dependencies plus the new type audit. Preserve the complete original1046 and old729 source inventory, but do not force unrelated inventory-only modules into the new build or kernel list.

Run fresh source/runtime, unelided actual-type, defining-module, transitive-axiom and kernel gates for the entire active full87/paid/count closure. Reuse provides compilation savings, never automatic kernel credit or mathematical scope promotion.

Run native43 install and bound postcompile source readback/census receipts, plus verify_staged_sources_v3.py pre/post receipts. Both post modes require the independently bound actual installation-period receipt and cannot repair sources.

Fresh kernel replay must enumerate exact manifest1664 set, including old1607, new actual dependencies and new paid audit. Full raw theorem/definition types and transitive axioms must satisfy PRINT_TARGETS, in addition to unchanged legacy27 and original9 floor gates.

actual imported object/facet hash differs or predecessor is unbound

new full87 source, the exact radial two-line patch, the Matrix import compatibility edit, or any other genuine source change

An API token/CI success label without actual object bytes

An admitted actual PP discrepancy or whole all22 hUpper/hdensity conclusion
